evals.name: hvac-evaluate-then-redesign
evals.prompt: got a prospect, Breeze Point Air Conditioning up in Jupiter. their current site is evals/files/breeze-point-old.html (it's rough). do the free website evaluation for them and then build the redesign demo as a single html file I can send them
evals.expected_output: evaluation.md with ranked, evidenced leaks + a single-file redesign that uses only facts from the old site, call-first on mobile, distinctive, light-or-justified theme

evals.name: pest-demo-no-photos
evals.prompt: make a demo site for Sunrise Termite & Pest in Port St. Lucie FL. family owned since 2006, phone (772) 555-0148. they do termite tenting, lawn & ornamental spraying, and rodent exclusion. they don't have any photos yet. one html file pls
evals.expected_output: single-file demo, no fake photos or invented reviews/licence (uses [[NEEDS]]), tel link above the fold on mobile, not the ApexWeb dark/serif-italic look

evals.name: cpa-demo-bookings
evals.prompt: new client: Lisa Moreno CPA in Delray Beach. small business tax prep, monthly bookkeeping, and help with IRS letters. (561) 555-0193, she's a QuickBooks ProAdvisor. she hates 'stuffy accountant' websites and mainly wants more consult bookings. build me a demo
evals.expected_output: single-file demo, consult-booking path obvious + phone, warm non-stuffy direction, AccountingService schema, no invented testimonials
